Coram : ARUN MISHRA*, M.R. SHAH
Foreign Awards (Recognition and Enforcement) Act, 1961: s.7 – Agreement between NAFED and Alimenta S.A. for export of groundnut (commodity) for the season 1979-80 – Agreement contained arbitration clause – Terms and conditions were as per FOSFA 20 contract, a standard form NAFED was a canalizing agency for the Government of India for export of commodity – Clause 14 in the agreement was that in case of prohibition of export by executive order or by law, the agreement would be treated as cancelled – NAFED could not export the entire quantity due to damage
Decision Date : 22-04-2020 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 667/2012 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
